answer: An identity joins only through a propagation thread: an agent threads its history into the newcomer's record, and the newcomer solves a floating join puzzle that shifts per attempt, costing 4 CPU-hours of sequential work. Each identity posts a 300 POA bond locked 45 epochs, 100% slashed when two identities share one thread. A reef of auditors samples threads each epoch; one reading like shale, thin copied history, triggers a fresh puzzle. Trust builds like a glacier: influence starts at zero until five graded epochs pass. 1,000 fakes cost 300,000 POA plus 4,000 CPU-hours.
